# CollectiveStateResilience

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The capacity of a networked collective state to withstand node-level failures or external interventions without transitioning to another state. Critical for designing fault-tolerant TCC fabrics and neuromorphic reservoirs that maintain function under perturbation.
